formatting.fileFormat: Word document. "For submission and review, please submit the manuscript as a Word document. Do not submit your manuscript in PDF format." Figures as separate files (1 file per figure), not embedded in the text; tables at the end of the manuscript file, not as images or separate files. Recommended file sizes: individual files no more than 500 kB and not exceeding 1 MB; total for all files not exceeding 5 MB (not including video).
formatting.font: 10-, 11-, or 12-point font size ("Use 10-, 11-, or 12-point font size, double-space text, and leave right margins unjustified (ragged).")
formatting.margins: Right margins unjustified (ragged); no numeric margin widths are stated
formatting.pageNumbers: "Start each of these sections on a new page, numbered consecutively, beginning with the title page."
formatting.referenceStyle: AMA Manual of Style (11th edition). "Number references in the order they appear in the text; do not alphabetize." "In text, tables, and legends, identify references with superscript arabic numerals." "List all authors and/or editors up to 6; if more than 6, list the first 3 followed by 'et al.'" Journal references include the issue number in parentheses after the volume number; abbreviate journal names per PubMed. "AI, LLM, and chatbots should not be used to generate or format references."
formatting.coverLetter: Required: "Include a cover letter and complete contact information for the corresponding author" (tag: Include: All Journals / Exclude: JNO) — affiliation, mailing address, email, telephone — and state whether related papers from the same study have been published, posted, or submitted elsewhere.
formatting.supplement: Section is titled "Online-Only Supplement" (the "Supplement" variant is tagged Include: JNO and JHF only). "Online-only material should be submitted in a single Word document with pages numbered consecutively." The first page lists the number and title of each element. Items are cited in the main text and "numbered in order of citation in the text (eg, eTable 1, eTable 2, eFigure 1, eFigure 2, eMethods)". "Online-only text should be set in Arial font, 10 point in size, and single-spaced" (main heading 12 pt bold, subheadings 10 pt bold). Online-only tables: title Arial 12 pt bold, footnotes 8 pt. Online-only figures: title Arial 12 pt bold, legends 8 pt; photographs .jpg or .tif at 300 dpi, 3-5 inches wide. Supplement references in a separate numbered reference section. Trial protocols with complete statistical analysis plans are cited in Methods and submitted as supplemental content for randomized trials. The Data Sharing Statement is published in an online supplement linked to the article.
formatting.titlePage: First page of the manuscript file. "It should include a manuscript title; the full names, highest academic degrees, and affiliations of all authors" (if an author's affiliation changed since the work was done, list the new affiliation too); "name and complete contact information for corresponding author"; "manuscript word count (not including title, abstract, acknowledgment, references, tables, and figure legends)".

abstracts.other: "Include a structured abstract." Structured abstracts are required for reports of original data, meta-analyses, and systematic reviews. "Abstracts are not required for Editorials, Viewpoints, and special features." (tag: Include: All Journals except JNO and JHF). "Do not use abbreviations in the title or abstract and limit their use in the text." No information may appear in the abstract that is not in the text. keyPoints.rules: "In the manuscript, include a separate section called 'Key Points' before the Abstract." (tag: Include: Specialty Journals, JNO, JHF). "Limit this section to 75-100 words or less." "(required only for research and review manuscripts)". Question: "Focused question based on the study hypothesis or goal/purpose. Limit to 1 sentence." Findings: "Results of the study/review. Include the design" (eg, clinical trial, cohort study), primary outcomes with basic numbers and whether results are significant, without test statistics; "Can include 1 to 2 sentences." Meaning: "Key conclusion and implication based on the primary finding(s). Limit to 1 sentence." Original Investigation: "A list of 3 Key Points is required". Systematic Review section: Key Points 75-100 words. Narrative Review row: "No Key Points". Research Letters: no Key Points. NOTE: the 75-100 word sentence sits in shared text after a JAMA-tagged line whose comment says the tag covers only that one line; one fetch read it as JAMA-only, so treat the exact limit with mild caution.

journalNotes: The instructions page is a template shared across JAMA Network journals with visible 'Include:/Exclude:' tags; JAMA Internal Medicine's code on the page is IMD (also covered by 'SJs' / 'Specialty Journals' / 'All Journals'). Conflicting tags exist for Special Communication (included in the Categories row, excluded from the descriptive section) and Brief Report (one tag 'Include: JAMA and SJs' would include IMD, but the Categories row and other tags explicitly exclude IMD; Brief Report is therefore not listed as an IMD type).

Cover letter is required ("Include a cover letter and complete contact information for the corresponding author"; tag Include: All Journals / Exclude: JNO), including whether related papers from the same study were published, posted, or submitted elsewhere.

Supplement: the section is "Online-Only Supplement" (not the JNO/JHF "Supplement" section); single Word document with pages numbered consecutively; online-only text in Arial 10 pt single-spaced; items named eTable/eFigure/eMethods in citation order.

Editorials and Invited Commentaries are not described as submission types; Editorials appear only in "Abstracts are not required for Editorials, Viewpoints, and special features." Comment & Response, Guide to Statistics, and Insights do not appear on the page. Consensus Statements and Clinical Practice Guidelines are tagged for JNO/JHF (and DER) only, not IMD.
Publication model: "If accepted for publication, all articles are generally published Online First and then again in a print/online issue." (tag: Include: Specialty Journals).

Open access (tag: Include: CAR, DER, IMD, NEU, ONC, OPH, OTO, PED, PSY, SUR): articles become freely available 12 months after publication at no charge (with copyright transfer); optional author-paid open access is "Payment of $6000 and grant of a Publication License to the journal." (CC-BY-NC-ND, or CC-BY only for funders that require it); waivers/discounts for eligible authors from Hinari Core Offer countries.
Embargo (tag: Include: All Journals / Exclude: JNO and JHF): "Authors should not disclose the fact that their manuscript has been accepted" until it is published.

Referral: at submission authors "may choose to have manuscripts that are not accepted by the journal referred to" a JAMA Network specialty journal or JAMA Network Open, with reviewer comments if available (tag: Include: All journals except JNO and JHF).
Peer review: "The journal uses a single-anonymized peer review process"; reviewer identities are confidential while author identities are visible to reviewers.

"For all reports of research, authors are required to provide a Data Sharing Statement" (published in an online supplement); "Authors of research articles should follow the EQUATOR Reporting Guidelines." (tag: Include: SJs, JNO, and JHF).

Titles: "Please limit the length of titles to 100 characters (including spaces) for reports of research" and other major articles; "60 characters for shorter article types such as opinion articles and Letters" and for subtitles; clinical trials, meta-analyses, and systematic reviews need a study-type subtitle; avoid declarative titles, titles stating result direction, and questions.

Figures: "Each figure for the main article must be uploaded as a separate file."; "In general each figure should be no larger than 1 MB."; "Do not submit figures with more than 4 panels unless otherwise justified."; minimum resolution ≥350 ppi (photographs) and ≥600 ppi (line drawings); no pie charts, 3-D graphs, or stacked bar charts; figures with labels/arrows/markers must be submitted in 2 versions (with and without markers). Tables single-spaced in 10- or 12-point font with titles preferably no longer than 10 to 15 words.

AI: content created by AI/LLMs is discouraged unless part of the formal research design; any AI use must be reported in the Acknowledgment section (tool name, version, manufacturer, dates, description, confirmation of author responsibility); AI may not generate or format references; "Use of AI, LLM, and chatbots to draft Opinion manuscripts, Letters to the Editor, and Online Comments is not permitted."; AI-created or -manipulated clinical images are not permitted.

All authors must complete an Authorship Form and a Publishing Agreement; conflicts of interest (3-year window) and funding/role-of-funder statements are required in the Acknowledgment; authors without conflicts must say so.
